-- fs --
home/evan/a/x
home/evan/b/y
home/evan/c/z
-- script --
latency 40ms
start /home/evan/b
size 60 9
note the parent is not read yet when ← goes there: the cursor still ends on the folder left, b
press left
state dir /home/evan
state current b
note and going in again finds the cursor where it was in b
press right
state dir /home/evan/b
state current y
